name: fm-match-analyst
description: Ask Claude about your live Football Manager match: stats, shots, players, shape and momentum from FMMatchLens's capture.
long_description: A read-only analyst for Football Manager 27. It reads the match FMMatchLens is capturing (its local API on 127.0.0.1:16726) or the match archives it saves, and gives Claude the score, momentum, team and player stats for any stretch of the match, every shot with xG and location, cards and substitutions, average positions and team shape in and out of possession, the pass network, and where the ball is won and lost. Pause a match and ask what is going wrong, or ask for a printable post-match or half-time report. It never changes anything in the game. Needs FM27 with BepInEx and the FMMatchLens plugin.

api_url.title: FMMatchLens API
api_url.description: Where FMMatchLens's local API answers. Leave as is unless you changed its port.

archive_dir.title: Match archive folder
archive_dir.description: Folder with FMMatchLens's .fmlens match archives, if not in the usual place (FM27-BepInEx/BepInEx/plugins/FMMatchLens/data/matches under the game's Steam folder).

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where your verdicts on answers (feedback.jsonl) and printable match reports (reports/) are saved. Leave empty for Documents/FM Match Analyst.

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.description: The whole picture in one call, by moment of the game: game state, what stands out, in and out of possession, transitions, set pieces, plan against reality, players, bench.

tools.name: get_phases
tools.description: In possession, out of possession, transitions and set pieces for any stretch of play.

tools.name: get_sequences
tools.description: Why did that goal happen? Each goal and big chance traced back to the start of its move, with the moment of the shot and patterns.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Did the change work? Each tactical change: the stretch before against the stretch after, and what else happened.

tools.name: get_match_state
tools.description: Score, clock, your team, xG, possession, momentum, goals, cards, substitutions.

tools.name: get_team_stats
tools.description: Team stats per half, per 15 minutes or for any window.

tools.name: get_players
tools.description: Ratings, condition, sharpness and stats per player, for the match or a window.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Shots with xG and location, goals, cards, subs, corners, fouls, saves, key passes, turnovers.

tools.name: get_shape
tools.description: Average positions in and out of possession, line height, length, width, pass network, where the ball is won and lost.

tools.name: get_tactic
tools.description: The applied tactic: formations, roles, instructions, mentality and changes.

tools.name: list_matches
tools.description: The live match and saved match archives.

tools.name: load_match
tools.description: Read the live match or a saved archive.

tools.name: build_report
tools.description: A printable post-match one-pager or half-time sheet, saved as an HTML page: every number from the match, with your analyst's verdict.

tools.name: note_feedback
tools.description: Save your verdict on an answer, with the match situation, to improve the analyst.
